title: Inline agent bundle documentation artifact
description: The agent bundle a repository installs into itself: the components it carries and what they render to on every supported host. "Inline" is the `project` output profile, whose files are merged into the repository's own dot-directories rather than installed as a self-contained plugin. A repository has at most one, so this artifact documents exactly one bundle; the bundles a repository publishes for others are documented by installable-agent-bundles.json instead. Produced by `cairn agent docs`. Specified by docs/formats/inline-agent-bundle.md. This $id is an identifier, not a fetchable URL. No schema here sets additionalProperties: false -- adding a property is a non-breaking change. Composed from spec/v1 by `npm run codegen` -- do not edit. The shared definitions live in spec/v1/_common.json.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this payload format. A consumer accepts a higher patch or minor and rejects a higher major.

id.description: The slug this artifact publishes under. Defaults to the bundle name.

title.description: The human label used in navigation.

bundle.title: DocumentedBundle
bundle.description: One agent bundle, normalized from its `agent-bundle.yaml` and rendered for every host it supports.

name.description: Bundle name: lowercase kebab-case, and the prefix another bundle references it by.

version.description: Bundle version, as the manifest spells it.

manifestSchemaVersion.description: The `schemaVersion` of the source `agent-bundle.yaml`, which versions the format authors write and is unrelated to this artifact's `schemaVersion`.

legacy.description: True when the source is a native plugin read through `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` rather than an `agent-bundle.yaml`.

source.description: Path to the bundle root, relative to the repository or collection root.

graph.description: Which components reference which skills, keyed by referencing component name.

targets.description: One entry per host and output profile the bundle renders into.

component.title: DocumentedComponent
component.description: A skill or subagent, as authored. `body` is the Markdown beneath the frontmatter, carried verbatim so a documentation site can render the component without reading the bundle.

description.description: The `description` frontmatter field, which is what a host matches a request against.

source.description: Bundle-relative POSIX path to the source file.

metadata.description: Frontmatter fields other than `name` and `description`, exactly as parsed.

body.description: Markdown body beneath the frontmatter, verbatim and unrendered.

files.description: Bundle-relative POSIX paths of files bundled alongside the component, such as a skill's references or scripts.

components.title: DocumentedComponents
components.description: Everything the bundle carries, by component kind. `hooks` is the hook configuration document and `mcp` the MCP server configuration document. A kind no selected target emits into a selected profile is omitted rather than shown empty -- which is why `hooks` is absent from a project-profile render: hooks are plugin-profile only on every target.

hookFiles.description: Bundle-relative POSIX paths of executables the hook configuration invokes.

dependency.title: DocumentedDependency
dependency.description: A bundle this one may name components in, through a `bundle/name` reference. Resolution is one level deep and never transitive.

name.description: The dependency's bundle name, which is also the reference prefix.

diagnostic.title: BundleDiagnostic
diagnostic.description: A finding raised while parsing or rendering the bundle. Codes are documented in docs/formats/diagnostic-codes.md.

component.description: The component the finding is about, when it is about one.

quality.description: How faithfully the source maps to the host: an `approximate` mapping reaches the host in a changed form, an `unsupported` one does not reach it at all.

remediation.description: What an author can do about it.

generator.title: ArtifactGenerator
generator.description: The tool that produced the artifact.

name.description: npm package name of the generating tool.

jsonDocument.title: BundleJsonDocument
jsonDocument.description: A JSON configuration document carried by the bundle, with the path it was read from.

marketplaceListing.title: MarketplaceListing
marketplaceListing.description: Listing metadata from the bundle manifest's `marketplace:` block. Structure is validated by the parser; whether it is complete enough to publish is `agent package`'s question, so a half-filled block still appears here.

displayName.description: Human label, preferred over the bundle name in a listing.

summary.description: One-line description for a catalog row.

description.description: Long-form description for a listing page.

license.description: SPDX identifier, as the manifest spells it.

icon.description: Bundle-relative POSIX path to the icon asset.

publisher.title: BundlePublisher
publisher.description: Who publishes a bundle or a collection.

renderedArtifact.title: RenderedArtifact
renderedArtifact.description: One file the bundle renders into, described but not carried. Content is deliberately omitted: the artifact documents the shape of an installation, not a copy of it.

path.description: POSIX path relative to the target and profile root.

origin.description: Emitted only for artifacts contributed by a target-native overlay. Absent means portable.

rule.title: DocumentedRule
rule.description: A rule: a component plus how a host decides to apply it.

activation.description: When the rule applies: unconditionally, on a path match against `globs`, at the model's discretion, or only when named.

globs.description: Path patterns the rule applies to. Meaningful only when `activation` is `files`.

starterPrompt.title: StarterPrompt
starterPrompt.description: A suggested opening prompt a host may offer for the bundle.

targetRender.title: TargetRender
targetRender.description: What the bundle produces for one host, in one output profile. `profile: "project"` is the inline form, merged into a repository's own dot-directories; `profile: "plugin"` is the installable form, a self-contained directory with its own manifest.

target.description: The host this render is for.

profile.description: The output profile. `project` is inline; `plugin` is installable.
